lines: Two a.m., downtown. This offer just popped up. Would you take it?
Eighteen forty. Seven minutes to the pickup, then a thirty-one minute trip to the far suburbs.
Now add the pickup and the twenty-five minute drive back, empty. That's sixty-three minutes of your night.
Eighteen forty for sixty-three minutes is about eighteen dollars an hour. Your bar is forty. Pass.
The trip time lies. Count the pickup and the drive back, every time.
RideSentinel does this math in one second. Early access: ridesentinel dot app.
lesson_text: Trip time lies. Count the drive back.
title: Would you take $18.40 at 2 a.m.? | Pass or Take #1
caption: It looks like $36 an hour. Count the pickup and the empty drive back and it is really about $18.
